claims.text: Variate-token transformers generalise from 10% of training data on ETTh1, ETTh2.
iTransformer is best characterised as inverted transformer treating variates as tokens.

evidence.description: iTransformer maintains within 30% of full-data MSE using 10% of ETTh1 and ETTh2.

methodologies.name: iTransformer
methodologies.description: inverted transformer treating variates as tokens

limitations.text: Evaluation is restricted to public benchmarks and may not reflect production settings.
Reported gains use a single held-out split; results across seeds vary by more than the headline MSE difference.

future_work.text: Extending the evaluation to include DLinear and NLinear as baselines.
Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
